target: Owned localhost storefront fixture, not an external product or customer study
visitor_profiles: One running-shoe shopper with a $60 budget; one with a strict $10 budget
limitations: An integration demonstration with manually chosen synthetic profiles, not validation against human behavior.
The model chose actions; a real Chromium browser executed them against a local HTTP server.
Outcome confirmation used a supplied DOM assertion plus the fixture server's counted cart write.
The signup flow was separately verified with deterministic model decisions in the browser integration tests.
Timing is not a throughput guarantee and token counts are not an invoice.
